dependencies.admission: DependencyCoordinator.require_ready(task_id) before task GREEN and merge; unresolved -> waiting_dependency; rejected -> repair reason
dependencies.scope: manifest/lock claims belong only to the serialized resolver owner

tests.baseline: capture_baseline(root, critical_paths_including_support, trusted_collected_ids) BEFORE producer work; save_baseline outside producer writable root
tests.evidence: toolchain.suite_evidence(language, stdout, report_path, exit_code) before report deletion
tests.gate: evaluate_run(baseline, staged_root, evidence, allowances=reviewed_exact_exceptions); GREEN only if integrity.green and environment.verify() succeeds
tests.persist: evidence/counts/findings + environment fingerprint/inputs + source_hash(staged_root) in supervisor artifacts

runtime: prepare(mode='runtime') independently, never rely on test-only packages
isolation: Windows venv/cache is not Linux evidence. Container validation must build/cache Linux dependencies or report BLOCKED_ENV. No fallback to host product execution.
